gradient-signal.description: The signal spectrum. Mint to blue to violet to coral, used for actions, borders, and light crossing a surface. Never for text.

gradient-quiet.description: Low-energy depth field for raised surfaces.

principles: Fields morph and drift slowly; interface responses are quick and exponential.
Every animation has a prefers-reduced-motion alternative.
Content is visible by default; motion enhances, never gates.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary in-page action. Signal-spectrum fill with dark ink, drifting slowly.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; min-height:52px; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:13px 18px 13px 22px; border-radius:999px; color:oklch(0.12 0.03 278); background:linear-gradient(120deg,oklch(0.78 0.14 184),oklch(0.67 0.2 250) 40%,oklch(0.66 0.23 286) 68%,oklch(0.76 0.17 25)); background-size:180% 180%; font:600 14px/1 Geologica,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; box-shadow:0 11px 34px oklch(0.55 0.2 281 / 0.2); transition:transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform:translateY(-3px) scale(1.015); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid oklch(0.78 0.14 184); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary action. Dark fill with a signal-spectrum hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; min-height:52px; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:13px 22px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:999px; color:oklch(0.965 0.012 255); background:linear-gradient(oklch(0.15 0.035 273),oklch(0.15 0.035 273)) padding-box,linear-gradient(120deg,oklch(0.78 0.14 184),oklch(0.66 0.23 286) 68%,oklch(0.76 0.17 25)) border-box; font:600 14px/1 Geologica,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { transform:translateY(-3px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid oklch(0.78 0.14 184); outline-offset:4px; }

components.css: .ds-studio img { display:block; width:100%; border:1px solid oklch(0.36 0.06 270 / 0.12); border-radius:1rem; box-shadow:0 24px 65px oklch(0.24 0.09 278 / 0.15); transition:transform 900ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1),box-shadow 900ms; } .ds-studio figcaption { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; margin-top:0.9rem; font-size:0.8125rem; color:oklch(0.41 0.036 262); } .ds-studio:hover { transform:translateY(-0.65rem) rotate(-0.4deg); } .ds-studio:hover img { transform:scale(1.018); }

narrative.summary: A deep-ink engineering portfolio lit by a moving signal spectrum. Mint, blue, violet, iris, and coral trace a path from perception research to AI product work. Hand-drawn marks reference eye tracking, networks, layers, and making. A pale studio room holds the separate art practice.
rules: The Track Separation Rule: signal mint marks engineering evidence, iris marks research, studio paper marks personal making.
The No Orange Rule: orange and warm startup neutrals are prohibited.
The Illuminated Surface Rule: gradients describe moving signal, depth, or light crossing a surface. Gradient text stays prohibited.
The Doodle Has Meaning Rule: every hand-drawn mark maps to perception, attention, connection, layers, or making.
The Two-Voice Rule: Geologica speaks in complete ideas, DM Mono annotates the system.
The Signal Depth Rule: shadows follow a transformation or a physical layer, never decorate every container.
